title: BiDiAr – Bibliography of Digital Archaeology. Open Bibliographic and Citation Data
description:
Open bibliographic and citation dataset of BiDiAr (Bibliography of Digital Archaeology), built from the reference lists of the journal Archeologia e Calcolatori (vol. 1–37, 1990–2026).

It contains linked tables of works, persons and citations, formatted citations, a CSL-JSON export for Zotero and an interactive citation graph.
